versioning.consent: account sudo enroll, or account approveEnrollment(uint256,uint16) then operator first enroll

yieldMarketCountNote: C3 table heading says 32, but has 30 rows (21 Venus, 4 Lista, 5 Aave); no unspecified markets added

borrow.note: #64 strategy earn simulation (chain 97 only). Each collateral asset has one fixed market; leveraged ETFs are not listed. LTV lines derived on chain: target=min(tier cap, F/2), deleverage=2F/3.

borrowV2.note: Strategy earn routing v2 (chain 97 only, simulated venues and rates). Runs next to v1 (`borrow`), which is untouched. One portfolio account uses v1 or v2, never both. Interface: docs/borrow-routing-v2.interface.json. This is the set with the third-review fixes (draft6); the set it replaced is under `previous` and its registry is paused for new risk.

simulatedRatesBps.note: simulated; owner can change them. Venus supply vaults (vUSDT/vUSDC/vUSD1/vU) pay borrow rate x utilization, about 0 until someone borrows, so opening straight into them is gated (negative carry); switching into them is not

previous.note: The draft5 set this one replaced. Its registry is paused for new risk (no open, migrate or vault switch on the old executor); repayments, collateral withdrawals, deleverage, releases and rewards there stay open. Routes, vaults, tokens and markets were the same ids and addresses as above.

demo.note: RoutingDemoTestnet: a demo account owned by OWNER; every position closed again. The deleverage step tightens the QQQB/USD1 route lines and resets them (the shared lending oracle is not touched).

RoutingDemoTestnet on the draft6 set: a demo account owned by OWNER; every position closed again. The deleverage drill is skipped on the public chain (it would tighten a route every account shares); it runs on a local fork only.

cashSwapper.note: AtpBorrowCashSwapper (add-on, docs §17): bound to this executor; a new v2 set needs a new swapper.
